items.html: The Behinat Dechura de AA is explained, hence we shall now explain the Behinat Nukva, since she is made of the sorts of the Melachim de BON. We must clarify the appearance of this sort, and the entire AA will be clarified along with it.This is because the entire Atzilut was only sorted and corrected by Iburim(pl. for Ibur), and every Partzuf was corrected and sorted by the Partzuf Elyon above it. By mating with the Nukva, it sorted the parts that this Tachton needs, they were there in the Nukva in Behinat Ibur of twelve months, and it was corrected.
